scripts.build: ng build admin && ng build candidates && ng build clients && dotnet build services/platform-api -c Release
scripts.api: node scripts/run.mjs dotnet watch run --project services/platform-api/src/Platform.Api --no-launch-profile
scripts.db:up: node scripts/run.mjs docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
scripts.db:down: node scripts/run.mjs docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/run.mjs dotnet ef database update --project services/platform-api/src/Platform.Infrastructure --startup-project services/platform-api/src/Platform.Infrastructure
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.libs.json --noEmit && ng build admin --configuration development && ng build candidates --configuration development && ng build clients --configuration development
scripts.test: npm run test:libs && npm run test:apps && npm run test:api
scripts.test:apps: ng test admin --watch=false && ng test candidates --watch=false && ng test clients --watch=false
scripts.check:migrations: node scripts/run.mjs dotnet ef migrations has-pending-model-changes --project services/platform-api/src/Platform.Infrastructure --startup-project services/platform-api/src/Platform.Infrastructure
